		s:gsub(".", function(c) table.insert(t, c) return c end)

	end

local function KZPW_fake_script()

	mainui.Position = UDim2.new(0.187, 0, 2, 0)

		if input.KeyCode == togglekey then
			if Opened.Value == false then
				mainui:TweenPosition(UDim2.new(0.187, 0, 0.771, 0))
				Opened.Value = true
			elseif Opened.Value == true then

end
